source: Cyberpunk RED — Night City Tarot (RTG DLC v1.1)

deck_rules.trigger: When 3+ damage dice rolled for a Melee or Ranged Attack show 6s, draw the top Tarot card and apply it instead of a normal Critical Injury.
deck_rules.multi_injury_bonus_damage: If a card inflicts multiple Critical Injuries, each Injury also deals +5 HP damage unless the card says otherwise.
deck_rules.post_resolution: After resolving, place the card on the bottom of the deck. Only one card can be pulled per game session.
deck_rules.campaign_shuffle_rule: After the first pull, don’t shuffle until every card has appeared once.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.effect: All of the victim’s cyberware is inoperable for 1 hour. Cyberlimbs hang limp and behave like dismembered meat limbs.
cards.additional_penalty: If the victim cannot sense opponents, they take an extra −4 to Checks (as if in smoke/darkness).
cards.no_cyberware_case: Suffer Foreign Object Critical Injury and 3d6 Humanity Loss.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.effect: GM chooses one piece of the victim’s cyberware; it is destroyed (repairable). Victim is Deadly On Fire.
cards.no_cyberware_case: Victim is Deadly On Fire and one worn/held weapon malfunctions (Action to clear).

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.effect: Victim suffers Foreign Object Critical Injury, but instead of move-triggered bonus damage they must beat DV 15 Resist Torture/Drugs or take 3d6 HP damage.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.effect: The next three successful Attacks against one opponent in this combat automatically cause Critical Injuries.
cards.notes: Applies to Light Melee Weapons; not to Poisons/Biotoxins/Stun Batons or other weapons that normally can’t crit.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.effect: GM selects a Player. That Player chooses one Head crit and one Body crit; the victim suffers both.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.effect: Attack deals double its post-armor, post-multiplier damage.
cards.cost: If a weapon made the Attack, that weapon is destroyed beyond repair.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.effect: Attack hits the head regardless of aim.
cards.melee_bonus: If Melee, the victim becomes the defender in a grapple with the attacker.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.effect: Armor at the hit location is further ablated by 5, even if the Attack didn’t penetrate.

cards.name: Strength
cards.effect: Attack deals +25 damage, added before armor SP subtraction and before multipliers.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.effect: Victim suffers Lost Eye twice (penalty applied once).
cards.additional_penalty: If left with no way to sense opponents, they take −4 to all Skill Checks (as if obscured).

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.ranged_case: GM randomly selects a new target; the Attack hits that target instead.
cards.melee_case: Attacker immediately falls prone and the Attack misses.

cards.name: Justice
cards.effect: For 1 minute, victim suffers −5 Evasion vs Melee and cannot dodge Ranged Attacks.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.effect: Victim is knocked prone and suffers Spinal Injury and Whiplash.

cards.name: Death
cards.effect: Victim immediately rolls one Death Save. On a fail, they drop to 0 HP and are unconscious for 1 minute.
cards.aftereffect: On regaining consciousness, they regain 3d6 Humanity (up to max).

cards.name: Temperance
cards.effect: Victim chooses one limb to be Dismembered and a different limb to be Broken.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.effect: Attack hits the head. Victim suffers Brain Injury and Lost Ear.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.effect: Victim suffers Cracked Skull, Crushed Windpipe, and Whiplash; these cause no bonus damage.
cards.buff: For 1 hour, victim ignores the effects of the Seriously Wounded state (can’t feel pain).

cards.name: The Star
cards.ranged_case: Attack hits the first target, then automatically hits a second enemy within 20 m (GM’s choice); if none, it hits the original target again in the body. Roll new damage for the second hit.
cards.melee_case: Victim suffers Broken Ribs and Collapsed Lung.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.effect: Victim suffers Foreign Object twice (once head, once body).
cards.melee_weapon_rider: If drawn by a melee weapon Attack, the weapon is stuck in the victim and the attacker is disarmed.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.effect: If the victim carries explosives, one explodes immediately (GM chooses). Otherwise, GM selects a non-weapon item on the victim to be destroyed beyond repair.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.effect: Victim suffers Crushed Fingers on one hand and Dismembered Hand on another.

cards.name: The World
cards.effect: The attacker takes an extra Turn immediately after this one; during it they get +5 to any Skill Check, ignore all Wound State penalties, and don’t roll Death Saves if Mortally Wounded.
